purpose: Close library-dependent numerical and boundary ambiguities before any real GA1 mask or economic result is read.
price_basis: BID OHLC in quote-price units after exact point scaling; calculations use float64 but source OHLC identity remains integer packed units

EMA.seed: first output at bar n-1 is arithmetic mean Close[0:n]

RSI14.seed: mean first 14 gains and first 14 losses from deltas t=1..14; first RSI at bar 14

ROC5: 100*(Close[t]/Close[t-5]-1), first at bar5; zero denominator fails unavailable

CCI20.mean_deviation: mean absolute deviation from window arithmetic mean

ADX14.DM: up=H[t]-H[t-1], down=L[t-1]-L[t]; +DM=up iff up>down and up>0 else0; -DM=down iff down>up and down>0 else0; DM[0]=0

gate_comparisons.TREND_EMA_ORDER: strict > for BUY, strict < for SELL
gate_comparisons.TREND_SLOPE: each one-bar EMA slope strictly side-aligned
gate_comparisons.EMA_CROSS: BUY fast[t]>mid[t] and fast[t-1]<=mid[t-1]; SELL fast[t]<mid[t] and fast[t-1]>=mid[t-1]; within inclusive last N completed signal bars

availability.tick_candidate: signal-TF indicators use last completed signal bar strictly before triggering quote
availability.close_candidate: signal-TF indicators may include the just-completed signal bar
availability.MTF: context bar is usable only when its completion_source_index is strictly less than final candidate availability_source_record_index
